tasks.title: Hash-chained audit ledger
tasks.description: Append-only ledger; each entry hashes the previous.
tasks.details:
src/jangus/kernel/ledger.py: append(event), verify_chain(), fail-closed on write error. Port from v1 remote/ledger.py.

[2026-11-02T11:47:33-05:00] Plan: kernel/ledger.py, JSONL file, one entry per line {seq, ts, event, prev, hash}; hash = sha256 of canonical JSON of (seq, ts, event, prev); genesis prev = 64 zeros. Ledger.open verifies the whole chain (corrupt or torn file = ledger_corrupt fault, fail closed). append writes bytes + flush + fsync; any OSError, or a file size that is not what we last wrote (second writer / fork), sets a blocked flag and raises ledger_unavailable; blocked ledger refuses all later appends and effects_allowed is False (B06). Unserializable event raises ledger_event_invalid without blocking. verify_chain raises on tamper. Known limit: deleting trailing entries is not detectable by the chain alone (needs an external anchor); parking-lot item, not built here. Add 3 FaultCodes. Tests in tests/test_ledger.py.

tasks.title: Kernel executor with intent, verify and reconcile
tasks.description: Core loop: persist intent, execute, verify, persist result; reconcile after crash.
tasks.details:
src/jangus/kernel/executor.py plus fake tools. Intent+attempt in one transaction before effect; independent verify; reconcile adopts matching result, retries only proven absence, otherwise marks unresolved.

[2026-11-02T15:11:36-05:00] Plan: kernel/executor.py. Order per effect: policy.decide -> (reject|queue: ledger entry only) -> state.record_intent (action row + budget charge, one txn, stores normalized args JSON) -> ledger intent entry -> execute -> verify -> ledger result entry -> state.record_result. Ledger events carry hashes only, never args or results. Tool exception or failed verify = status unresolved (blocks retry). recover(): for each action left at intent, reconcile: applied -> verify then adopt; absent -> re-run once with the same key (no second charge); unknown -> unresolved. Preconditions: ledger.effects_allowed and state writable, else raise before any effect (B06). Crash tests inject a BaseException at named checkpoints. State change: add args_json column and 'unresolved' status, plus list_open_actions and writable (schema still v1, no deployed data).

[2026-11-02T15:12:24-05:00] Built and tested locally: Adds kernel/executor.py (decide, intent+charge, ledger intent, execute, verify, ledger result, record result; recover() reconciles actions left by a crash: applied adopts, absent re-runs once, unknown stays unresolved). Ledger carries hashes only. State store gains args_json, an unresolved status, list_open_actions and writable. Local: ruff clean, mypy strict clean, pytest 80 passed (19 new; B01-B06 coverage incl. crash before effect, after effect, after verify, after ledger result). Awaiting CI before done.
